_meta.definition: The unifying capability across all tables is the management of order-related details, including customer, employee, shipper, and financial aspects.

columns.name: OrderID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in orders

columns.name: CustomerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Customer entity

columns.name: EmployeeID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Employee entity

columns.name: OrderDate
columns.description: Stores formatted text strings representing the date when orders were placed.

columns.name: RequiredDate
columns.description: Stores order's intended delivery date (repeatedly entered as "RequiredDate").

columns.name: ShippedDate
columns.description: Stores formatted string representations of order shipment dates.

columns.name: ShipVia
columns.description: Stores the method of transport used for order delivery (e.g., "ShipVia").

columns.name: Freight
columns.description: Stores fixed string value for freight charge in orders.

columns.name: ShipName
columns.description: Stores the names of shipping companies handling orders.

columns.name: ShipAddress
columns.description: Stores detailed street addresses for order shipment locations.

columns.name: ShipCity
columns.description: Stores the destination city for order shipments.

columns.name: ShipRegion
columns.description: Stores the region where orders are shipped.

columns.name: ShipPostalCode
columns.description: Stores postal codes for order shipment locations.

columns.name: ShipCountry
columns.description: Stores the country of destination for order shipments.
